parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- stack: stack.

- stackgroup: stack group.

- template: template.

- templatescratch: resource scenario.
